identity.name: Squidoor (CL-STA-0049) Web Shell to Renamed-Debugger Backdoor with Multi-Protocol C2 — EDR + NGFW Stitch (T1505.003 / T1127 / T1071)
identity.summary: CL-STA-0049 web shells lead to the Squidoor backdoor loaded by a renamed cdb.exe (fontdrvhost.exe + config.ini), persisted as EPolicyManager, with Outlook-drafts, DNS and ICMP C2. Validates that the endpoint behaviours and synthetic NGFW records for the published indicators stitch on one host into one incident.
identity.description: Unit 42's Squidoor report (2025-02-27) describes a suspected Chinese cluster, CL-STA-0049, hitting government, defense, telecom, education and aviation targets in Southeast Asia and South America. Entry is via IIS exploitation and web shells (OutlookDC.aspx, Error.aspx, TimeoutAPI.aspx) decoded with certutil; the actor spreads shells with curl and Impacket and once disguises one as a certificate. Squidoor (aka FinalDraft), a Windows and Linux backdoor, is executed by a renamed Microsoft Console Debugger saved as C:\ProgramData\fontdrvhost.exe that loads shellcode from config.ini, persisted by a scheduled task Microsoft\Windows\AppID\EPolicyManager. Its C2 is selectable among ten transports including an Outlook mail API channel (refresh-token login, a Pastebin 'Local365' check-in, drafts with p_/r_ subjects), DNS tunnelling and ICMP tunnelling. The simulation reproduces the endpoint behaviours safely on the run host (inert .aspx stand-ins, a renamed /bin/sh or cdb.exe running a recon-only config.ini, an EPolicyManager cron/scheduled-task entry, Graph-drafts-shaped HTTP and Pastebin-shaped GET to the operator's stage host, DNS lookups of the five published domains through the lab resolver, padded ICMP and long-label DNS to a lab zone) and emits two synthetic NGFW record types (EAL traffic + WildFire threat) forming the NDR leg, both carrying the same src_host/src_ip/src_user: an EAL recurring-beacon record to the published IPs and a WildFire malicious verdict for config.ini's published SHA-256. CR-MP-0023 fuses the legs on src_host.

campaigns: CL-STA-0049 Squidoor / FinalDraft espionage against government, defense, telecommunication, education and aviation sectors in Southeast Asia and South America (since March 2023)

techniques.name: Masquerading: Match Legitimate Name or Location

execution.framework_reference_id: SIM-MP-023 — Squidoor (CL-STA-0049) web shell to renamed-debugger backdoor with multi-protocol C2, EDR + NGFW stitch

prerequisites.description: Cortex XDR agent on the run host (Linux primary; Windows variant for steps 01 and 03-06).
Operator HTTP log collector (or Broker VM) ingesting panw_ngfw_traffic_raw and panw_ngfw_threat_raw, plus a lab resolver at LAB_RESOLVER and a stage host at STAGE_HOST.

payload.code:
# Summary of the scenario steps; the scenario YAML is the executed source of truth.
STAGE=/tmp/cortexsim-mp023
WEBROOT="${WEBROOT:-$STAGE/www}"
mkdir -p "$WEBROOT" "$STAGE/drop" "$STAGE/ProgramData"
# step-01: inert .aspx stand-ins decoded into the webroot, recon shell
# step-02: Error.aspx copied to server.crt and PUT to the stage host
# step-03: /bin/sh copied to ProgramData/fontdrvhost, runs a recon-only config.ini
# step-04: crontab @reboot entry tagged EPolicyManager
# step-05: Graph-drafts-shaped HTTP to the stage host + DNS lookups of the report domains via the lab resolver
# step-06: padded ICMP to the stage host + long-label DNS to a .invalid lab zone
# step-07/08: NGFW EAL beacon + WildFire threat record via the EAL CLI, carrying src_host/src_ip/src_user
echo cortexsim-mp023-summary

input_variables.name: STAGE_HOST
input_variables.description: Lab host that receives the web-shell PUT, the Pastebin/Graph-shaped requests and the ICMP.

input_variables.name: LAB_RESOLVER
input_variables.description: Resolver every report-domain lookup is sent to (@LAB_RESOLVER); no session is opened to any result.

input_variables.name: COLLECTOR_URL
input_variables.description: Operator log collector for the synthetic NGFW records.

expected_artifacts.description: Inert .aspx web-shell stand-ins named as in the report, written by the web-service account.
Renamed system binary fontdrvhost executing config.ini from a ProgramData-style path.
DNS queries for the five published CL-STA-0049 domains via the lab resolver.
Synthetic NGFW EAL and WildFire records carrying the run host as source.
expected_artifacts.expected_value: panw_ngfw_traffic_raw dst in published IPs; panw_ngfw_threat_raw filedigest = config.ini SHA-256

cleanup.code:
# Windows cleanup lines live in the scenario cleanup.commands: schtasks /delete EPolicyManager, and Remove-Item of C:\ProgramData\cortexsim-mp023 plus the Explorer\UUID test key.
crontab -u www-data -l 2>/dev/null | grep -v cortexsim-mp023 | crontab -u www-data - || true
rm -rf /tmp/cortexsim-mp023 /tmp/mp-023-ngfw-eal.yml /tmp/mp-023-ngfw-threat.yml
echo '[CortexSim] SIM-MP-023 cleanup complete.'

biocs.name: MP-023 Web Service Account Decodes ASPX Web Shell Into Webroot
biocs.description: A web-service account (www-data, or an IIS app-pool identity) writes .aspx files named like the CL-STA-0049 web shells after a base64 decode (base64 -d on Linux, certutil -decode on Windows).
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.FILE and event_sub_type in (ENUM.FILE_CREATE_NEW, ENUM.FILE_WRITE)
| filter action_file_name in ("OutlookDC.aspx", "Error.aspx", "TimeoutAPI.aspx")
| filter actor_effective_username in ("www-data", "apache", "nginx") or actor_effective_username contains "IIS APPPOOL" or actor_process_image_name in ("base64", "certutil.exe", "cp", "powershell.exe")
| fields agent_hostname, actor_effective_username, actor_process_image_name, action_file_path, _time

biocs.name: MP-023 ASPX Web Shell Copied To Certificate Extension And Uploaded
biocs.description: A web-service account copies an .aspx script to a .crt/.cer file and uploads it with curl -T — the report's web-shell-as-certificate spread.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name in ("cp", "curl")
| filter action_process_image_command_line contains ".aspx" or (action_process_image_command_line contains "-T" and action_process_image_command_line ~= "\.(crt|cer)")
| filter actor_effective_username in ("www-data", "apache", "nginx")
| fields agent_hostname, actor_effective_username, action_process_image_command_line, _time

biocs.name: MP-023 Renamed System Binary Fontdrvhost Executes Config Ini From ProgramData
biocs.description: A process named fontdrvhost runs from outside System32 (ProgramData-style path) with config.ini as its argument — the renamed-cdb Squidoor loader (renamed /bin/sh on the Linux path).
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter lowercase(action_process_image_name) in ("fontdrvhost", "fontdrvhost.exe")
| filter lowercase(action_process_image_path) not contains "system32"
| filter action_process_image_command_line contains "config.ini"
| fields agent_hostname, actor_effective_username, action_process_image_path, action_process_image_command_line, action_process_image_sha256, _time

biocs.name: MP-023 EPolicyManager Persistence Launching Renamed Fontdrvhost
biocs.description: A persistence entry named EPolicyManager whose action launches fontdrvhost from a ProgramData-style path: schtasks /create under Microsoft\Windows\AppID, or a crontab @reboot entry written by a service account.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_command_line contains "EPolicyManager" or (action_process_image_name = "crontab" and actor_effective_username in ("www-data", "apache", "nginx"))
| filter action_process_image_command_line contains "fontdrvhost" or action_process_image_name in ("crontab", "schtasks.exe")
| fields agent_hostname, actor_effective_username, action_process_image_name, action_process_image_command_line, _time

biocs.name: MP-023 Service Account Ping With Oversized Patterned ICMP Payload
biocs.description: A non-interactive service account runs ping with a large payload size and a custom fill pattern — the CIcmpTransChannel tunnel shape.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name in ("ping", "ping.exe")
| filter action_process_image_command_line ~= "(-s|-l)\s+([5-9][0-9]{2}|[1-9][0-9]{3,})" or action_process_image_command_line contains " -p "
| filter actor_effective_username in ("www-data", "apache", "nginx") or actor_effective_username contains "IIS APPPOOL"
| fields agent_hostname, actor_effective_username, action_process_image_command_line, _time

abiocs.name: MP-023 Recurring Communications From Run Host To Rare CL-STA-0049 Domains
abiocs.description: NGFW EAL abnormal recurring communications to a rare domain: a tight recurring ssl/443 burst from the run host to destinations the fleet has not contacted, here the published CL-STA-0049 domains/IPs. Behavioural deviation on the source host, enriched by the indicator match.
abiocs.logic:
dataset = panw_ngfw_traffic_raw
| filter log_source_type = "eal"
| filter dst_hostname in ("support.vmphere.com", "update.hobiter.com", "microsoft-beta.com") or dst in ("209.141.40.254", "104.244.72.123", "47.76.224.93")
| comp count() as sessions, avg(bytes_sent) as avg_bytes by src, endpoint_device_name, dst_hostname
| filter sessions >= 5
| fields src, endpoint_device_name, dst_hostname, sessions, avg_bytes
abiocs.causality_anchor: Learned per-host NGFW egress baseline -> recurring burst to fleet-rare destinations, anchored to src / endpoint_device_name (the run host shared with the endpoint leg).

correlation_rules.name: Squidoor CL-STA-0049 Web Shell to Multi-Protocol C2 — Endpoint + NGFW Stitch
correlation_rules.logic: BIOC(MP-023 Web Service Account Decodes ASPX Web Shell Into Webroot) AND BIOC(MP-023 Renamed System Binary Fontdrvhost Executes Config Ini From ProgramData) AND (BIOC(MP-023 EPolicyManager Persistence Launching Renamed Fontdrvhost) OR IOC(any MP-023 report domain)) AND (ABIOC(MP-023 Recurring Communications From Run Host To Rare CL-STA-0049 Domains) OR IOC(file-sha256 f663149d618be90e5596b28103d38e963c44a69a5de4a1be62547259ca9ffd2d)) within 1800s on the same src_host (xdr_data agent_hostname = panw_ngfw_*_raw endpoint_device_name, reconciled with src_ip by XSIAM endpoint entity resolution) -> one high-severity CL-STA-0049 incident spanning endpoint and network.

xql_queries.name: MP-023 Web Shell Write Followed By Recon Shell From Web Service Account
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 3600)
| filter actor_effective_username in ("www-data", "apache", "nginx")
| filter action_file_name in ("OutlookDC.aspx", "Error.aspx", "TimeoutAPI.aspx") or action_process_image_name in ("id", "hostname", "uname", "whoami.exe")
| comp count() as events by agent_hostname, actor_effective_username
| filter events >= 2
| fields agent_hostname, actor_effective_username, events

xql_queries.name: MP-023 Renamed Fontdrvhost Spawns Host Reconnaissance
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 3600)
| filter lowercase(causality_actor_process_image_name) in ("fontdrvhost", "fontdrvhost.exe") or lowercase(actor_process_image_name) in ("fontdrvhost", "fontdrvhost.exe")
| filter action_process_image_name in ("id", "hostname", "uname", "ip", "ps", "whoami.exe")
| comp count_distinct(action_process_image_name) as recon_tools by agent_hostname
| filter recon_tools >= 1
| fields agent_hostname, recon_tools

xql_queries.name: MP-023 Service Account Outlook Drafts C2 Shape And Report Domain Burst
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 3600)
| filter actor_effective_username in ("www-data", "apache", "nginx")
| filter dns_query_name in ("support.vmphere.com", "update.hobiter.com", "microsoft-beta.com", "zimbra-beta.info", "microsoftapimap.com") or action_process_image_command_line contains "mailFolders/drafts"
| comp count() as hits by agent_hostname
| filter hits >= 1
| fields agent_hostname, hits

xql_queries.name: MP-023 Long Label DNS Query Burst From Service Account
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 3600)
| filter dns_query_name != null
| alter first_label = arrayindex(split(dns_query_name, "."), 0)
| filter len(first_label) >= 32
| comp count() as long_labels by agent_hostname
| filter long_labels >= 5
| fields agent_hostname, long_labels

xql_queries.name: MP-023 Squidoor Config Ini WildFire Verdict Landed For Run Host
xql_queries.query:
dataset = panw_ngfw_threat_raw
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 3600)
| filter filedigest = "f663149d618be90e5596b28103d38e963c44a69a5de4a1be62547259ca9ffd2d"
| comp count() as verdicts by src, endpoint_device_name, verdict
| fields src, endpoint_device_name, verdict, verdicts

threat_scenarios.name: Squidoor Web Shell to Multi-Protocol C2 — Endpoint + NGFW Stitch
threat_scenarios.description: CL-STA-0049 tradecraft on one host (web shells, renamed-debugger loader, EPolicyManager persistence, Outlook/DNS/ICMP C2 shapes) plus synthetic NGFW records for the published indicators, stitched into one incident on src_host.

threat_steps.objective: Endpoint BIOCs fire for the web-shell write, renamed loader and persistence on the run host.
preconditions: XDR agent on the run host.
steps: Observe the MP-023 BIOCs on agent_hostname.
success_criteria: Web-shell, renamed-fontdrvhost and EPolicyManager BIOCs fire on the same agent_hostname.

threat_steps.objective: Published indicators enrich: report domains (DNS), IPs (NGFW EAL) and config.ini SHA-256 (WildFire) match Unit 42 intel.
preconditions: Lab resolver and log collector configured.
steps: Search the tenant for the indicator values.
success_criteria: IOC alerts name CL-STA-0049 / Squidoor for at least one domain, IP and the hash.

threat_steps.objective: CR-MP-0023 groups endpoint and network alerts into one incident on src_host.
steps: Open the incident for the run host.
success_criteria: One incident holds both EDR and NDR alerts within 1800 s.

preventive_controls: Patch and front internet-facing IIS servers with WAF / Advanced Threat Prevention; enable Cortex XDR Anti-Webshell Protection on web servers.
Block or alert on debugger binaries (cdb.exe) outside developer workstations and on system binary names executing from ProgramData.
Sinkhole or block the published CL-STA-0049 domains and IPs via EDL; restrict server egress so web servers cannot reach mail APIs, Pastebin or arbitrary ICMP/DNS destinations.
detection_engineering: Alert on web-service accounts writing script files into webroots, especially after base64/certutil decoding.
Alert on scheduled tasks or cron entries whose action is a binary in ProgramData named like a system binary.
Hunt for servers making Microsoft Graph mailFolders/drafts requests or Pastebin GETs from non-browser processes.
